prompt:
Create a draft visual asset for Vintage Telnet using the supplied art direction.

Asset type: creature

Target: Borrador de fauna natural del Bosque de Nhal para validar anatomía y lectura sensorial; no integrar a runtime.

Canonical name: Agujaumbría

Art direction: Escena oscura pero legible de sotobosque. Mostrar un adulto completo desplazándose pegado a una raíz grande: tronco bajo y flexible, cuatro extremidades cortas con apoyos anchos, cabeza pequeña integrada al cuello, grandes fosas sensoriales laterales, ojos reducidos, cresta dorsal segmentada de láminas finas flexibles y cola corta gruesa parcialmente prensil. La cresta debe leerse como órgano sensorial, nunca como púas, plumas o arma. Luz natural filtrada, sin estética mágica.

Aspect ratio: landscape

Prompt: Create one landscape wildlife scene in the deep understory of the Bosque de Nhal. Show one complete adult Agujaumbría, 70–90 cm total length, moving close alongside a large damp root and trunk structure. Its trunk is low, flexible and compact/triangular in section. It has exactly four short main limbs with broad supports and separated toes. The small head blends into the neck and has two large lateral sensory pits plus reduced eyes. Along the back is a segmented crest of thin flexible lamellae reacting unevenly to nearby air currents and vibration; these lamellae are sensory, not spines, feathers or weapons. The tail is short, thick and partially prehensile for stabilization. Matte fine-textured skin with small soft plates on shoulders/flanks. Low three-quarter side view, full anatomy readable despite the dim forest. Natural filtered daylight, damp roots, inclined trunks, wet rock and dense understory subordinate to the animal. No magic.

Canon sources supplied by the Art Director: vintage-telnet/ART_WORLD_GUIDE.md; vintage-telnet/CREATURES.md; vintage-telnet/REGIONS.md; vintage-telnet/SUPPLEMENTAL_REGIONAL_FAUNA.md

Do not include: No spikes, quills, feathers or weaponized dorsal structures; No glowing eyes, bioluminescence, magic, runes or supernatural effects; Do not add echolocation imagery or sonar effects; Preserve exactly four main limbs; do not add extra legs or wings; No long exposed tail; tail remains short, thick and stabilizing; Do not make it a heroic predator, dragon, dinosaur or giant insect; Avoid bright open clearings and dominant golden/ochre lighting; No readable text or HUD

IDs (reference only): agujaumbria

Notes: Ficha de Dirección de Arte. La referencia de Nhal fija únicamente ambiente, raíces, humedad y luz regional; no redefine la criatura. Una sola generación por ejecución. No publicar ni integrar a assets/.

Use the attached reference images according to the art direction and constraints above.

issues: Dorsal crest reads as rigid, blade-like spikes/plates rather than thin, flexible laminae (looks weaponized).
Tail is too long and exposed; it should be short, thick and only partially prehensile.
critique.reasoning: The scene and four-limbed adult pressed to a large root are correct and lighting is suitably dark and natural. However the dorsal crest is depicted as a series of stiff, blade-like plates that read as spikes/weaponized structures rather than a flexible, sensory lamina; this violates the 'no spikes/quills/weaponized dorsal structures' and the requirement that the crest read as a sensory organ. The tail extends visibly long behind the animal instead of being short and thick, violating the 'no long exposed tail' constraint.
